context.classical: 十一月丁火，或仲冬水多癸旺，全无比印，此作弃命从杀……三冬丁火，甲木为尊，庚金佐之，癸戊权宜酌用可也。
context.template: SEASON geng.chen · reading: You were born in late spring, when Earth runs the season and buries Metal more than it feeds it. Your season asks first for Wood to break that Earth open and then for Fire to temper you, and you come into your own when both are within reach.
